SETTINGS.TITLE: Assistant

ASSISTANT.ASK_TRACKING: How is the follow-up of this case going?

AI_FOLLOW_UP.TITLE: Delegate to AI follow-up
AI_FOLLOW_UP.INTRO: The agent writes to the customer in this conversation, answers questions with the company sources and lets you know when it's done.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.OBJECTIVE: What do you want to achieve?
AI_FOLLOW_UP.OBJECTIVE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: get the customer to confirm quote 1520, or learn why not
AI_FOLLOW_UP.INSTRUCTIONS: Instructions for the agent (optional): talk to it like a teammate
AI_FOLLOW_UP.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Customer since 2020, be formal. Interested in the yearly plan; if they ask for a discount, say you will review it. For support questions, answer with the canned responses. Do not offer the monthly plan.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.ON_FINISH_ASSIGN: Notify me and assign me the conversation
AI_FOLLOW_UP.NEED_OBJECTIVE: Write what you want to achieve
AI_FOLLOW_UP.STOP_CONFIRM: Cancel the AI follow-up? The agent will stop writing to the customer.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.TEMPLATE: Template to reopen WhatsApp (24 h window closed)
AI_FOLLOW_UP.TEMPLATE_AUTO: Let the agent pick the best one
AI_FOLLOW_UP.TEMPLATE_HELP: The agent picks among {n} approved templates and fills in their variables with real data.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.TEMPLATE_NONE: This inbox has no approved templates the agent can use: if the window is closed, you will be notified.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.BUTTON_HINT: The AI agent follows up with the customer for you: writes, answers from company sources and uses templates when the WhatsApp window is closed
AI_FOLLOW_UP.LEGACY_HINT: Open the classic follow-up agent (agents from the AI Agents module)
AI_FOLLOW_UP.NO_CONVERSATIONS: This contact has no conversations: the agent needs one to write to them.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.NEW_CONVERSATION_HINT: No conversations yet: delegating opens one in this inbox, assigned to you.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.NO_REACHABLE_INBOX: Add their phone or email to delegate the follow-up.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.AI_NOTE: What the agent knows about the customer (contact AI note)
AI_FOLLOW_UP.AI_NOTE_NONE: This contact has no AI note.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.AI_NOTE_ADD: Add it on the contact page
AI_FOLLOW_UP.SOURCES_NONE: The company has no canned responses: if the customer asks something not in the AI note, it will hand it to a person.
AI_FOLLOW_UP.SOURCES_CANNED: To answer questions it checks the company canned responses and the contact AI note.

PHONE.TITLE: Use {name} on my phone
PHONE.NOTE: {name} full screen on your phone: type or dictate. It installs like an app.
PHONE.QR_ALT: QR code to sign in to Dali
PHONE.SCAN: Point your phone camera at the code: you sign in right away. It works once.
PHONE.OR_URL: Or open {url} on your phone and sign in with your email and password.
PHONE.INSTALL_HINT: Once inside: on Android, menu › “Install app”; on iPhone, Share › “Add to Home Screen”.
PHONE.ERROR: Couldn't generate the code. Try again.

NOTICES.UNSUPPORTED: This browser doesn't allow notices. On iPhone, add Dali to the home screen and open it from the icon.
NOTICES.ERROR: Couldn't turn on notices. Try again.
